name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including content, client/project association, portal visibility and private communication drafts. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; explicit exits restore that context, while direct or untrusted origins fall back safely. A discreet `Documentos / ...` path under the title exposes every real folder ancestor as a hoverable link back to that folder, including the root and unassigned locations. Moving the document uses the same DocumentFolderSelect as the create form (doc-folder-select): a search over name, path, client and project that shows the current folder's full path, never offers automatic folders, and sends the new folder_id on save. The responsive header clamps long titles, keeps portal visibility and client metadata independent, and shows concurrent state episodes with their duration. The Acciones menu remains separate from the non-wrapping Cancelar/Guardar pair. The compact notes entry opens a wide modal whose message fields grow with their content and whose Cancelar/Guardar cambios pair stays in a fixed bar, enabled only once a message changes; it performs an immediate notes-only PATCH for client messages and legacy custom notes, leaving unrelated page edits pending; normalized observations use the audited state workflow and may link to needs-fix. Failed saves keep the modal draft open. Stored commercial-proposal versions and issued collection accounts open as immutable PDF records: identity, association, folder, messages and workflow controls are read-only, the exact archived PDF is previewed and downloaded once, and private observations remain manageable. The three contract mirrors (combined, product and service) stay in Contratos, open through list navigation with version and synchronization date, preview the current draft PDF, export PDF or Markdown, and offer no editor, save, rename, move, duplicate, archive, delete or drag. Markdown tools, the full-width editor with its Editar/Vista previa switch (the preview takes the editor's own box at document reading width), contained template previews with bounded scrolling and dual PDF download remain available only for editable Markdown documents.
